item.title: Block Propagation Sets Crypto’s Real Speed Limit
item.description: Propagation turns bandwidth and validation time into missed slots, reorg risk and higher data costs, making network design—not block time—the real speed limit.

item.title: SGX Opens Bitcoin and Ether Perpetuals to U.S. Institutions
item.description: CFTC authorization connects eligible U.S. firms to SGX’s existing crypto order book, but onboarding—not permission—will decide whether liquidity deepens.
